scope: observability, alerting, dashboard, and production gate map

signals.name: request_id_propagation
signals.local_evidence: .env.example defines REQUEST_ID_HEADER=X-Request-ID; backend health/ready responses echo X-Request-ID; backend request logs include request_id
signals.production_gate: must propagate request id through web, admin, backend, worker, crawler, logs, metrics exemplars, and traces in staging

signals.name: structured_json_logs
signals.local_evidence: .env.example and docker-compose.yml define LOG_FORMAT=json and LOG_LEVEL; backend uses slog JSON handler; access logs include request_id, user_id, tenant_id, route, status, latency_ms, and bytes; panic logs include request_id
signals.production_gate: must verify backend, worker, crawler, and access logs are JSON with request_id, user_id, tenant_id, route, status, latency_ms, and error fields

signals.name: opentelemetry_traces
signals.production_gate: must verify backend, worker, crawler, provider, export, and object storage spans in staging

signals.name: backend_worker_crawler_metrics
signals.local_evidence: .env.example and docker-compose.yml define METRICS_ENABLED=true and METRICS_PORT=9090; backend exposes Prometheus text metrics with HTTP request totals, status counts, route counts, duration total, and uptime
signals.production_gate: must expose API latency, queue delay, generation duration, export duration, crawler throttle, quota contention, and error counters

signals.name: frontend_error_reporting
signals.local_evidence: .env.example defines FRONTEND_ERROR_REPORTING_DSN empty for local alpha
signals.production_gate: must configure web/admin error reporting with release SHA and source map policy

signals.name: dashboards
signals.local_evidence: ops/observability/dashboards/stage0_rev2_overview.json defines required API, worker, provider, export, quota, crawler, object storage, billing, safety, admin, and frontend panels
signals.production_gate: must import and populate staging dashboards for API, worker, provider, export, quota, crawler, object storage, billing, safety, admin failures, and frontend errors

signals.name: alerts
signals.local_evidence: ops/observability/alerts/stage0_rev2_alerts.json defines go/no-go alert thresholds and routes
signals.production_gate: must configure paging/notification routes and prove alert threshold evaluation before private beta
